props.classMechanic_text:
PSYCHIC GIFTS

USING A GIFT

Gifts can only be used when a Trigger takes place (each gift lists its trigger). When this happens, you may spend an amount of Mind Points to apply the gift’s effects to the Trigger.

MP Cost Formula: max(5, 5 × the number of filled sections in your Brainwave Clock).

  • You may only use a single gift per Trigger.

Skill Enhancement Lv. 20 ― If a gift causes HP or MP recovery, or causes MP loss, increase the amount by 10.

Skill Enhancement Lv. 40 ― If a gift causes HP or MP recovery, or causes MP loss, increase the amount by 20.

THE BRAINWAVE CLOCK

When you first acquire the Psychic Gifts Skill, you also receive a Brainwave Clock.

  • Your Brainwave Clock has 4 sections, and it begins each scene empty.

  • After you resolve one of your gifts, fill 1 section of your Brainwave Clock (do so after the effects of the gift have been calculated and applied).

  • Your Brainwave Clock determines your gifts’ cost in MP, as well as their effectiveness (see above). You can still use your gifts even when the Clock is full.

  • Sections of your Brainwave Clock may not be filled in any way other than described above, and they may only be erased through the 【💥Brainwave Discharge】 Heroic Skill (see its description) or through effects that expressly influence Brainwave Clocks.

props.class_lore:
Thought, desire and emotion are powerful forces, whose echoes influence the stream of souls that flows throughout the world.

Espers have developed the ability to connect with this spiritual web of sensations, which scientists have dubbed “the soul network”, and rely on it to transmit information and improve their physical and mental abilities. Because of this, each Esper applies their powers in remarkably different ways
